verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own developer guide documents user call handling with state-based rules, call handling configurations and call forwarding targets. Its pricing page cites call queues with routing, auto attendant and visual voicemail, which points to native routing of calls to groups and to voicemail. However, nothing in the pack explicitly describes ringing a group sequentially versus simultaneously, or overflow rules that send unanswered calls to voicemail or an external number. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sequential vs simultaneous group ring modes, documented no-answer overflow to voicemail or another number, hands-on or independent corroboration.
